title: I Don't Need All the Answers
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When Job had seen the wondrous things
Heavenly Father made,
He understood: God sees it all,
and Job was not afraid.

[Chorus]
You may not understand it all,
and that's okay, you know;
The Lord is wise, His plan is good,
He'll never let you go.

[Verse 2]
"I trust You," Job said humbly then,
"You're wise, and You know best;
I don't need all the answers now."
And then his heart found rest.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; the questions can
all wait for morning light;
Heavenly Father's by your side,
His plan is good and right.

[Chorus]
mood: Resting music. A slow, sinking sway moves under the voice, like a heavy question being set down and left for morning. The first two verses keep that calm, steady settling as Job stops needing all the answers. By the last verse it drops lower and slower still, the pulse almost fading, trust taking the place of every question.
